currentPhase.description: RC715 remains the promoted standalone forensic baseline. RC718 is the active automation-ready development candidate and awaits the focused RC719 human naming and persistence gate. The validated Remote Agent Worktree is accepted for bounded multi-file development under explicit scope and test profiles.

developmentBaseline.candidate: RC718 editable imported plan naming candidate

promotedBaseline.candidate: RC715 durable library and rename candidate

authorizedWork: standalone functional, UX, accessibility, persistence, performance, test, and release improvements through bounded pull requests
bounded multi-file AI implementation through the accepted Remote Agent Worktree with exact baseline, machine-checkable scope and explicit test profile
permanent player CI and black-box behavioral protection
preparation of one bounded and reversible architectural seam
heldWork: localStorage to IndexedDB migration until a dedicated migration gate is accepted
prohibitedWork: maintaining a separate canonical standalone source outside GitHub
mixing a functional correction with a transversal architecture, storage, identifier, or contract migration
microservices before a demonstrated extraction need
synchronization of opaque global snapshots as the sole merge model
canonical identifiers derived from editable titles
direct UI coupling to storage or remote APIs
parallel AI implementation without exact baseline and machine-checkable scopes
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
presenting target architecture as current implementation
using the Remote Agent fast lane for workflows, governance, architecture, work packages, secrets or held platform domains

activeRisks.statement: Branch protection and mandatory review rules are not yet independently verified through repository policy evidence, and the Remote agent worktree / tested result context is not yet proven mandatory through a ruleset.
activeRisks.closureGate: repository policy audit and tested-result required-status rule completed

activeRisks.statement: Machine-checkable changed-file scope enforcement is active for the Remote Agent Worktree lane, but conventional pull requests and other AI workflows are not yet covered by a general scope-check CI.
activeRisks.closureGate: general pull-request scope-check CI accepted or explicit agent-lane-only policy accepted

activeRisks.statement: The imported baseline has strong reconstruction and test evidence, and the Remote Agent lane passed one real targeted browser suite, but the repository does not yet run the complete permanent player browser matrix on every sensitive pull request.
activeRisks.closureGate: permanent player CI and browser gate accepted

activeRisks.statement: The human promotion is recorded as accountable-owner attestation without raw device recordings or per-case human test logs in the repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or acceptance of owner attestation as the durable record

activeRisks.statement: RC718 plan-name editing passed bounded automated checks and an additional Remote Agent browser smoke but has not yet completed the focused Android and desktop close/reopen human gate.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Permanent player CI and representative black-box regression fixtures protect the promoted RC715 behavior before the first architectural seam is implemented. RC719 human validation is additionally required before RC718 can replace the promoted standalone baseline.

review.lastReviewedBy: Architecture & Repository Governor — GOV-REVIEW-0004 Remote Agent Worktree acceptance
review.nextReviewTrigger: first real product change through Remote Agent Worktree, RC719 human naming/persistence result, repository ruleset audit, first architectural seam proposal, serious regression, release provenance change, or phase-gate request
